A '''slicer energy field''' was a security device used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was deployed around the [[Alpha TR-8]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rordak]].
